crime: Every morning at first light, {WITCH_NAME}'s roommate woke her so they could go down to the courtyard and break the ice on the fountain for the birds.
When she was small, her mother had once tucked her back into bed and told her, "Sleep." She woke to her mother's footprints in the snow, running out through the gate.
One morning at first light, her roommate pulled the blanket back over her in their cell and said, "Sleep. I'll go alone from now on."

She climbed to the upper railing. Below, her roommate knelt alone at the fountain, breaking the ice. {WITCH_NAME} fixed her eyes on the last footprint her roommate had left in the snow, just behind her heels, and the next instant she was standing inside it, with not one track on the snow between. She slammed her roommate's head down on the iced rim, and the girl slid face first into the hole she had broken.

The prisoners found her face down in the ice hole, with one line of her own footprints leading from the door. They searched the snow for the lone pair of prints {WITCH_NAME}'s Magic always left wherever she landed, with no trail leading up to them. There were none anywhere. In the trial court, they ruled that her roommate had slipped alone on the iced rim.

Then one prisoner set her foot in that last footprint to retrace the slip, and found a smaller sole already pressed into the bottom of it. They realized that {WITCH_NAME} had stood in that footprint without ever walking there, and had struck her roommate down.
fields.epitaph: She would have come back, her hands still cold from the ice.
fields.epithet: The Girl Who Never Goes Back to Sleep
execution: A two-tier bunk bed rose on the execution stand in the trial court, its upper bunk heaped high with snow. She lay on the lower bunk under a blanket drawn tight to her chin and bound around the bed. The upper bunk tipped open and dropped its snow over her chest and face. The snow packed down over her. Beneath it, the blanket heaved, then stopped. The snow lay level and smooth across the lower bunk, and nothing stirred beneath it.

magic.name: One Glance Away
magic.text: She can teleport to any spot she looks at.
